text:
colin: caught another compact-row UX hit in QA. the Throughput column in the compact Routes view shows 't.../s' and users can't tell if it's RPS, tokens/sec, or byte/s. plus smoothing is hiding 200ms spikes we flagged in the usability session maria: oof. which compact size? 3-col 24px? colin: yep, the 3-up condensed rows. screenshot in the ticket. customers called out that the tiny smoothing made anomalies invisible tara: suggestion: switch to micro-unit labels inline (RPS, tok/s, KB/s) and expose full unit in the tooltip — keeps layout stable and reduces truncation oliver: agree. micro abbreviations for inline, but ensure aria-label or aria-describedby provides full text for screen readers: e.g. aria-label="Throughput, 420 RPS (requests per second)" pm-ani: copy note: product prefers 'Requests / sec' in docs, but on tight UI I'd pick 'RPS' for space. let's be consistent and add a glossary link in the expanded panel maria: smoothing: can we default to no smoothing in compact mode? i think smoothing on small canvases hides short, important bursts tara: yes default off for compact. add a tiny smoothing toggle in the expanded detail. microcopy: toggle label "Smooth traces" and a tooltip "Applies a 5-s moving average" colin: outlier handling idea: render subtle tick glyphs for flagged points but don't attach per-point tooltips. instead surface a single summary affordance at the end of the sparkline that says: "2 spikes 2m ago3". clicking opens the timeline drawer oliver: implementation detail: avoid DOM nodes per marker in compact rows. draw markers in canvas or background-image, and expose one accessible button. code sketch: ``` ``` markers themselves should be aria-hidden="true" visually present only maria: small a11y nit: when focus lands on the spark-summary, VoiceOver should read the summary and not iterate through hidden markers. ensure markers have aria-hidden and role="img" for the canvas fallback pm-ani: copy nit: prefer "spikes" in the UI for customer-facing tiny labels. docs/alerts can use "anomalies" tara: analytics: rename events to keep parity: sparkline_compact_summary_open (with count) and sparkline_compact_toggle_smoothing. avoid emitting per-point hover events in compact rows to reduce noise oliver: also add a metric flag in telemetry for legacy smoothing behavior: smoothing_default_compact=true/false so we can roll back if needed colin: edge-case: pointer-events:none on markers prevented NVDA users from activating the chart when markers were links. so we should not rely solely on pointer-events to hide tooltips maria: better pattern: markers aria-hidden="true" + role="presentation" and one focusable button that contains a visually-hidden full-text summary. example: ```
``` that preserves keyboard and screen reader behavior tara: microcopy for percentiles: show 'P95 latency' in tooltips. avoid '95th' which confused non-technical folks in the study pm-ani: agreed on P95. also change CTA text from "View details" to "Open timeline" in compact contexts colin: design-bot: uploaded two Figma variants: inline-micro-units + aggregate-button, and alt where unit column is widened. link: https://figma.redwood/proto/compact-units-1845678901 design-bot: variant files uploaded oliver: i'll prototype the aria-hidden markers + summary button and post a short GIF. QA can run VoiceOver + NVDA passes on the prototype maria: plan: oliver builds prototype -> tara + QA run a11y checks -> finalize copy with pm-ani -> ship behind prod-flag. estimate 1 dev day + design tweak + QA half day colin: thanks all. leaving a comment on the figma about the P95 copy and telemetry event names :thumbsup:
